title: CCAN
tagline: A mirror copy but with token gating feature and decentralize(can use custom domain and deploy buy user them self)
description:
We build this from scratch during the hackathon base on the NuxtJS and with token gating feature that allow user deploy new SBT for their new blog article, that user can mint the SBT as one-time payment for the article.

User can also mint the website's NFT pass that can access all blog article without mint each article's SBT.
how_its_made:
1. use the ERC1155 and ERC721 with SBT features
2. use the NuxtJS to build the whole SEO friendly web3 blogging platform
3. use vercel to deploy the platform
4. use the LIT to provide the token gating feature
5. while LIT do not supported network, we provide the server side solution to gating the content
